name: Lantau Conservation Fund (Conservation and Related Projects)
summary: Hong Kong government fund for conservation projects on Lantau, in three streams: conservation management agreements, research, and education and engagement. Local tax-exempt charities and non-profit companies apply.

amount.note: HK$250,000 minimum is a firm threshold; only the maximum is "generally" applied. Maximum is for the Conservation Management Agreement stream; Research HK$2.5m, Education HK$2.0m

applicant_types.quote: Local tax-exempt charities (only accept applications from organisations having legal personality)

geography.quote: Projects that contribute to the overall conservation of Lantau, raise community awareness on the conservation of Lantau, or engage the community to put conservation into practice may apply for funding support under the LCF.

access.quote: For each project, the Applicant Organisation shall complete an electronic-input Application Form, which is available on the LCF website.

amount.quote: the lower threshold limit for application is HK$250,000. Notwithstanding the above, each proposed Conservation and Related Project will generally be subject to the funding and duration limits in the following project stream: Project Stream Funding Limit (HK$ million) Duration Limit Conservation Management Agreement 13.0 3 years

window.quote: The application period will be announced through the LCF website.
